subject: One day without blame
alt: Subhani’s cartoon: a large gilt frame holds a portrait of Manmohan Singh. He wears a white cap and glasses, has a long nose, a black kurta with a red rose at the chest, sad eyes and a tear on his cheek. In front of the frame, a wooden table carries a heap of red roses. On the left stands an elderly man in a white kurta and pyjamas, with a white beard and glasses, holding red roses; beside him a small boy also holds roses. A speech bubble from the old man says: I HAD A JOLLY GOOD BIRTHDAY. NO ONE BLAMED ME FOR ANYTHING TODAY. The cartoonist Subhani’s signature is at the lower left.
chutki: A portrait of Manmohan Singh in a gilt frame: white cap, glasses, long nose, a black kurta with a red rose, sad eyes and a tear on his cheek. In front of the frame a heap of red roses lies on a wooden table, and on the left an elderly man in a white kurta and pyjamas stands with a small boy, both holding roses.

The needle is in the sentence in the bubble - I had a jolly good birthday, no one blamed me for anything today. The leader who was handed the blame for every difficulty gets, on his birthday, only roses. Inside the frame he is silent; outside, there is a smile; and in politics the ledger of blame never stops even for a day.
